gloss: the other shore; the far bank; the opposite side

definitions.gloss: the other shore; the far bank; the opposite side of a river or body of water
definitions.explanation: The bank or shore on the opposite side of a river, lake, or other body of water from where the speaker is. Can also be used figuratively for something that feels distant or unreachable.

examples.english: I can see someone on the other shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{泳|およ}いで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: I swam across to the other bank of the river.

examples.japanese: {向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The scenery on the far shore, lit up by the sunset, was very beautiful.

notes:
Compound of {向|む}こう (the other side; over there) + ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧ (shore; bank). The reading changes to ぎし through {連濁|れんだく} (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross to the other side
- {向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: the far shore is visible
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}: the opposite bank of the river

USAGE:
Sometimes used metaphorically to mean something distant or out of reach, similar to "the other side" in English. In Buddhism, ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ (the other shore) represents enlightenment or the afterlife.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対岸|たいがん}→対岸：17100_taigan⟧: the opposite bank — more formal and literary; often used in the expression ⟦{対岸|たいがん}→対岸：17100_taigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧ (someone else's problem, literally "a fire on the opposite bank")
- ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧: the other shore (Buddhist) — specifically refers to the Buddhist concept of the afterlife or enlightenment, or the equinox holiday period
